plugins.name: context-economy
plugins.description: Handoffs that survive a context reset: a /handoff skill that writes and verifies them, plus hooks that write one automatically before compaction takes the session and inject the right one into the next.

plugins.name: core-skills
plugins.description: Project-agnostic catalog skills bundled into one installable plugin. Each skill reads .claude/project-context.md for any project-specific facts it needs. Currently: catchup, worktree, commit, fix-bug, implement-plan, newbranch, next, plan-feature, pr, review-branch, review-mcp-descriptions, shepard, sync-worktrees, task-writer (with the bug-fix-verifier, runtime-integrity-reviewer, precedent-reviewer, docs-accuracy-reviewer, plan-reviewer, and surface-reviewer agents).

plugins.name: kendo-pm
plugins.description: Kendo project-management skills bundled into one installable plugin, for any project using Kendo (https://kendo.dev) for issue tracking. Requires the Kendo MCP server or the kendo CLI. Currently: kendo-cli, kendo-mcp, triage-reports.
